tagline: Turn what happens in your games into bodyweight exercises, at your own pace.
free: Squat Souls is free and open source.
altPlay: Play tab with a set to do
play: Pick your game and an intensity, then click an event or press its key. The exercises to do show up right below.
step1: Start a session, then play as usual.
step2: You die, you beat a boss: click the event, or press its key.
step3: A few exercises show up, 14 squats for example. Do them, then get back to it.
step4: A short recovery, then your history keeps track of every session.
recovery: A countdown to catch your breath between exercises, and a timer for planks and other timed exercises, on each side if needed.
history: A summary of the last 7 days and every session, ready to paste to your friends.
program: Your games, picked from the catalog or your own, your events, your exercises. The sample exercises are only a starting point.
settings: Limits per session, jokers, and an intensity for tired days.
noInteraction: You trigger the events, the app never interacts with the game
steam: Spots which Steam game is running
macosBlocked: On macOS, the first launch is blocked: here is how to open it
macosStep1: Open the app once, then close the warning.
macosStep2: Go to System Settings, Privacy & Security.
macosStep3: Click Open Anyway next to the Squat Souls message, then confirm.
footer: Squat Souls is free and open source, under the MIT license.
